parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Override the ACTIVE_SHOP preference (e.g. a screen's own ?shop= param). Empty = read the preference.

parameter.name: includePosScope
parameter.description: Also derive terminalIds + sessionIds for the selected shop (POS screens only — heavier, so off by default).

parameter.name: activeShopId
parameter.description: Validated selected shop facilityId, or null = All Shops (combined).

parameter.name: shopListJson
parameter.description: JSON array of {id,name} for the org's shops, ordered by name.

parameter.name: shopList
parameter.description: Same shops as a list of {id,name} maps, for server-side rendering.

parameter.name: sessionIds
parameter.description: When includePosScope + a shop is active: the shop's PosSession ids ( ['__NONE__'] if none) for an `in` filter; null = All (unfiltered).
